specific_waiting.value: 24 months of continuous coverage (cataract, hernia, joint replacement and listed conditions)

initial_waiting.value: 30 days from first policy commencement date (accidents excluded)

room_rent.value: Up to ₹2,000/day at 1–2L SI; ₹5,000/day at 3–4L SI; Single Standard A/C Room at ₹5L SI and above

copay.value: 20% co-payment for insured persons aged 61 years and above at entry or renewal

maternity.value: Excluded (Code Excl 18), except New Born Baby cover and assisted reproduction per schedule

ayush.value: Inpatient treatment under Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy in an AYUSH Hospital payable up to Sum Insured

daycare.value: All day care procedures covered up to Sum Insured

ncb.value: Cumulative Bonus 25% after first claim-free year, 10% per subsequent year up to 100% of Basic Sum Insured

renewal.value: Lifelong renewability with 30-day Grace Period for annual mode

sublimits.value: Yes: Cataract (₹12,000 to ₹50,000 per eye by SI band) and Modern Treatments capped per table
